home.hero.titleAccent: family names, given names and patronymic names
home.howItWorks.subtitle: Ukrainian grammar rules combined with machine learning.
home.howItWorks.genderDetection.title: Gender detection
home.howItWorks.genderDetection.text: If the grammatical gender is not specified, the library can detect it automatically from the patronymic name or given name.
home.howItWorks.machineLearning.title: Machine learning
home.howItWorks.machineLearning.text: Family names of noun and adjective origin decline differently, even when they end the same way. A machine learning model tells them apart to choose the right rule.
home.howItWorks.soundAlternation.title: Sound alternation
home.howItWorks.soundAlternation.text: Sounds in the word stem can alternate or drop out during declension. The library handles these changes according to the rules of the Ukrainian language.
home.howItWorks.vocativeCase.title: Vocative case
home.howItWorks.vocativeCase.text: The vocative form depends on the word stem, so even names with the same ending can have different forms. The library takes these differences into account.
home.howItWorks.compoundNames.title: Compound names
home.howItWorks.compoundNames.text: Hyphenated given names and family names are declined part by part, taking into account whether each part should change.
Depending on gender and ending, some family names do not change across cases. The library recognizes such cases and leaves these family names unchanged.
